title: Prepare for France's e-invoicing and e-reporting mandate
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
### Reduce Invoice Rejections and Deter Penalties


Validate invoices and reports against French requirements, preventing per‑invoice fines and reporting penalties from September 2026.


### Improve Operational Efficiency


Automate e‑invoice generation, routing, lifecycle status exchange, and e‑reporting to reduce manual rework.


### Increase Visibility and Control


Track invoice delivery, status outcomes and submissions to proactively manage exceptions and keep payments on track.


### Support Audit Readiness


Archiving with a complete transaction trail, tailored to French requirements.
